items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And Bill Winston drums. No, you don't remember those?

ctx.x: He played tuba, I'm not. Yeah, he probably even played Mighty Fine tuba. And Bill Winston drums. No, you don't remember those? Well, it's nice to know I never could quite get those guys lined up. There's so many Mississippi musicians. What bands passed through Natchez from other towns that you'd hear?
Not recently. It hasn't been. Oh, but, uh, I, I don't know.
